credits.title: The Witch's Boy
credits.overview: This is the story of a mother and son--a witch and a giant. To celebrate his 16th birthday the witch bakes her son a chocolate cake. But chocolate cakes are for boys and today this giant becomes a man.

credits.title: Coupons
credits.overview: A door-to-door Salesman sees his opportunity to snap an unlucky streak when a young boy opens the door at a large suburban home.

credits.title: Violent Night 2
